authorInfo.bio: Gustave Aimard (1818–1883) is the credited author of this historical edition. Works available in this collection include The Treasure of Pearls: A Romance of Adventures in California. The linked author record provides further bibliographic details.

description: "Stronghand; or, The Noble Revenge" by Gustave Aimard is a novel written in the mid-19th century. The story unfolds against the backdrop of the Western American frontier, delving into themes of bravery, honor, and the harsh realities of life in the wild.
